metadata.title: Vintage Sepia Portrait with Graphic Header

retrievalProfile.description: A sepia-toned vintage portrait of a child in adult clothing, featuring a top-right justified typographic block with horizontal rule accents.

recipe.visualDefinition: A grainy, sepia-toned photograph of a young child wearing a dark fedora and suspenders, holding a cigarette. The image has a soft-focus, aged quality. In the top right corner, a stacked typographic block uses condensed sans-serif fonts separated by thick horizontal lines.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark hat anchors the top of the central figure
The typographic block in the top right balances the subject's leftward lean
The smoke trail provides a delicate diagonal movement toward the center
The sepia palette unifies the photographic and graphic elements
coreInvariants: Sepia-toned monochromatic color scheme with slight green/yellow tint
Heavy film grain and soft-focus edges
Top-right justified typographic stack with horizontal rules

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The child is centrally located, captured from the waist up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, wide-brimmed fedora acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the hat, moves down to the face and hands, follows the smoke trail, and ends at the graphic header in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The background is a mottled, textured sepia void that provides high contrast for the subject's white shirt.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Brown/Black (hat, suspenders, and graphic bars)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed value range, emphasizing texture over color depth.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' is an elongated vertical oval
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and widths of the same condensed sans-serif family, separated by geometric bars.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the primary text.
Matches the ultra-condensed, flat-terminal look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned, grainy vintage photograph of a child in a fedora and suspenders against a textured, dark background. Ensure soft focus and a 19th-century aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of condensed sans-serif text in the top right corner. Separate the levels with thick horizontal bars. Use dark brown or black for the text and bars.

verificationChecks: Is the text justified to the top right?
Are there horizontal bars between text lines?
Is the grain texture visible across the entire image?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure horizontal bars are perfectly level
Confirm grain texture is not pixelated
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Sepia Portrait + Condensed Sans-Serif + Horizontal Rule Accents
